command:
set -e; EXPECTED=3091efd67e9642a4eb190e68bb827166e68bfd67; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL remote=$REMOTE; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; V=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -A6 -B1 'STREAM_VOICE_CALL' | head -n 10); D=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -A6 -B1 'STREAM_DTMF' | head -n 10); printf '%s
' "$V"; printf '%s
' "$D"; printf '%s
' "$V" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$D" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; printf '%s' "$APK" >/tmp/phase1c_apk_path; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav /tmp/ref-ui.xml /tmp/ref-keypad.xml; echo silent_audio_guard=true
